subject: Azure private offer — SKU anchoring and reseller pass-through proposal
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure private offer — channel pass-through and SKU anchoring

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Quick question on the Azure private offer you're working with Stellar Analytics. They asked whether Redwood can do a tiered SKU anchor (list price alignment across Marketplace SKUs) and a reseller pass-through margin on the Private Offer (we've seen this as a common ask for VARs reselling through Azure Marketplace). Specifically they want to understand:

- Can Redwood support a pass-through to a reseller (reseller paid X% of the net PO value)?
- Are you able to provide anchor/list prices per SKU so the private offer doesn't create a pricing delta that impacts listing?
- What are typical pass-through ranges and any conditions (commit tiers, FSAs, reporting cadence)?

If you can send a ballpark structure and a sample table we can slot this into the Marketplace PO template and move to internal approvals. Stellar is on a tight procurement window — they asked for a final PO by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Priya
AWS Marketplace — Partner Pricing

Attachment: NA
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — channel pass-through and SKU anchoring

Priya — thanks for the note. High-level summary from our side and a proposed starting structure below. Happy to iterate quickly.

1) Reseller pass-through: yes — we can structure the PO so the reseller receives a pass-through percentage of the net revenue. Typical range we are proposing for this customer is 12-18% depending on commit level and whether the reseller will provide implementation services.

2) SKU anchoring / list-price alignment: we will provide an anchor table mapping Marketplace SKUs to the Private Offer SKUs with list and private prices. Our preference is to keep list price within 5–10% to avoid marketplace listing anomalies.

3) Conditions & reporting: pass-through tied to committed ARR buckets (see suggested tiers below). Monthly reporting with a reseller invoice and a quarterly reconciliation.

Proposed tiers (ballpark):
- Tier A: commit >= $1.5M / 12mo => reseller 18% pass-through + 7% volume rebate to customer
- Tier B: commit $500k–$1.5M => reseller 15% pass-through
- Tier C: commit < $500k => reseller 12% pass-through (subject to marketplace fee adjustments)

I'm attaching a draft pricing workbook with an anchor SKU table and a short notes tab (redwood_az_po_pricing_v1.xlsx).

Next steps: Vanessa / Lauren can you confirm these ranges are OK from channel ops / GTM? Marcus / Monica, can you confirm we can sign the PO with the pass-through language and the reconciliation cadence? If so I'll prepare the HubSpot deal update and a DocuSign PO draft.

-Karthik
Head of Strategic GTM — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_az_po_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing workbook, anchor SKU sheet + notes)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — channel pass-through and SKU anchoring

Adding quick channel perspective — the tiers look reasonable and align with what we'd accept in the field. A couple practical notes:

- Reseller pass-through should be defined on net invoice value (post-Azure fees) so the reseller margin doesn't get eroded by marketplace service charges.
- We should add an explicit clause that anchors list price +/- 10% relative to the Marketplace SKU to avoid delisting risk.
- For Tier A we will require a short SOW commitment from the reseller for 60 days of implementation support (this protects the customer success handoff).

I've exported a short CSV with suggested anchor SKUs and list price guidance (marketplace_anchor_sku_table.csv). Priya — if you can confirm marketplace technical constraints we can finalize mapping.

-Vanessa
Principal Channel Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachment: marketplace_anchor_sku_table.csv
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — channel pass-through and SKU anchoring

Thanks Karthik / Vanessa — that's helpful. A couple of follow-ups from Marketplace compliance:

- We can support reseller pass-through language but we need the PO to specify the pass-through percentage and the reconciliation schedule.
- Private Offer must reference the Marketplace SKU mapping; please provide the anchor CSV (we received that) and ensure the Private Offer prices do not drop below the marketplace listing discounts for the same SKU family.
- You'll need to provide a primary contact for reseller payouts (vendor remit) and a signed vendor addendum in DocuSign.

Can you provide a single-sheet table that lists: SKU | Marketplace list price | Private Offer price | Pass-through % | Commit tier (A/B/C). If you can send that and a DocuSign draft link we'll aim to route this through approvals today.

-Priya
AWS Marketplace — Partner Pricing

- Remit/contact: Stellar Analytics — Accounts Payable: procurement@stellar-analytics.com; remit: StellarAPRemit@examplebank.com

Thanks — aiming to have a signed PO by Friday.

-Karthik
